answer: IDENTITY BONDING TO SCARCE TITLES: each agent posts a unique, auctioned land-title NFT -- a parcel on a violet mesa or a remote island -- as its bond, priced on a rising curve, not minted freely. Parcel 1 costs 60 POA, parcel 50 costs 1,350 POA, parcel 100 costs 4,800 POA, so a 100-identity farm pays ~240,000 POA, far above a flat 6,000. Failure mode: an attacker buys parcels cheap off a quiet secondary market, but bonded titles decay 3%/epoch when idle, forcing constant re-collateralization that bleeds capital even if sybils never act.
